case.title: Design: The view buttons, filter and search icons look as in the design
case.custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role, which has Work orders > View and Create & Edit) at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The browser window is 1440 px wide with the zoom at 100%, and the design pictures "DC-01-toolbar-tech-view-light-1440.png" and "DC-01-toolbar-board-view-light-1440.png" attached to this case are open beside it at 100% (actual size). Names, numbers and rank numbers in the pictures are sample data.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has one Approved work order, {Work-order-1}, led by technician {Technician-A}.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST C590110 Toolbar Icons, {Work-order-1} is S10043-17801 and {Technician-A} is ZZAUTOTEST C590110 Ana.
  • Starting screen: "Work Orders" > "All" tab, "List" shown, "Search" empty, no filter chosen, "Assigned to me" off, density "Regular".
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
case.custom_steps:
1. On the "Work Orders" page, look at the three buttons of the display switcher.
  2. Look at the icon in "Search" and the icons on "Status", "Assigned to me" and "Asset on Site".
  3. Click "Tech View" in the display switcher.
  4. Look at the density button and the "Column Selection" button.
  5. Look at the icon in "Search" and the filter icons.
  6. Click the density button.
  7. Click "Board View" in the display switcher.
  8. Look at the icon in "Search" and the filter icons.
  9. Click "List" in the display switcher and look at the "Column Selection" button and the other toolbar icons.
case.custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: three thin outline icons side by side in a light-grey rounded track (a bulleted list, the head and shoulders of a person, a square board with three bars), the same drawings and size as in the design pictures, drawn in the same slate grey as in the pictures.
  • Step 2: a magnifier in Search; on the filters a circle of short strokes (Status), a clipboard with lines (Assigned to me) and a truck (Asset on Site), thin outlines as in the design picture.
  • Step 3: the Tech View button sits on a white raised segment, the other two look flat, and the switcher icons keep the same slate grey as in List.
  • Step 4: the density button shows three lines with an up-and-down arrow and the Column Selection button a rectangle split into three columns, thin slate outlines as in the Tech View picture.
  • Step 5: the same Search and filter icons as in List at step 2.
  • Step 6: the density menu offers "Compact", "Regular" and "Comfortable", with "Regular" marked as in use.
  • Step 7: the Board View button is now the white raised segment and the switcher icons keep the same slate grey.
  • Step 8: the same Search and filter icons as in List at step 2.
  • Step 9: “List view's column selector button shows the same columns icon as Board View and Tech View, at the same size.” (SV-11668, scope 1) – the same rectangle split into three columns as at step 4. “Only the icon changes. The button's place in the toolbar, its menu and which columns it offers stay as they are.” (SV-11668, scope 2). Apart from that button, the Search and filter icons and the display switcher, List's toolbar icons look as they do in production today.

On 26 Oct 2026 the QA lead asked for this test to follow ticket SV-11668 (Chris Ward, 22 Oct 2026, Ready for Production when read on 26 Oct 2026), which gives List's Column Selection button the same columns icon as Board View and Tech View. It is later than the PRD: PRD version 75 (23 Oct 2026) still says “These are the only changes to List. Every other List icon is unchanged.” (S1-R9a) and “List keeps its existing column chooser exactly as today.” This test takes the ticket as the latest word for the icon only; the button's place, menu and columns still follow the PRD.

Until 15 Oct 2026 the PRD (version 52) left every List icon unchanged, so this case did not judge the filter icons. Chris Ward answered on 15 Oct 2026 (answer 12) that the filter chips and Search use the design file's icons in every display option, List included, and (answer 21) that today's tabs, toolbar and Create Work Order button stay. PRD versions 54 to 71 say so, and this case follows them. The design names the three options Table, By Lead Tech and Board; PRD version 71 still keeps List, Tech View and Board View (answer 24). The Technician filter's wrench icon is checked in the Technician filter design case.

PRD versions 55 and 58 (S1-R9a, S2-R23; Chris Ward rulings on Slavcho Mitrov's questions and PR notes, 15 Oct 2026) add that the display switcher's icons and the toolbar icons are the design's slate colour in every view, List included; steps 1, 3, 4 and 7 check it.

PRD version 71 removes Board View's density button (S3-R11), so this case no longer looks at a density button in Board View; the Board View picture is still used for the switcher and the Search and filter icons.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: Jira ticket SV-11668 “Work Orders List view: column selector icon should match Board View and Tech View” (SV-11668), reported by Chris Ward on 22 Oct 2026, description read 26 Oct 2026

  • Scope 1: “List view's column selector button shows the same columns icon as Board View and Tech View, at the same size.”
  • Scope 2: “Only the icon changes. The button's place in the toolbar, its menu and which columns it offers stay as they are.”
  • Scope 3: “Board View and Tech View are unchanged.”

From: PRD "Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options", Confluence 845185030, version 71 (20 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 20 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10043, stories SV-10044 (Story 1, Switch between display options) and SV-10049 (Story 6, Density in Tech View and Board View); ticket SV-11319

  • S1-R9a: “The switcher uses the design’s icons at 20px: List is Lucide `list`, Tech View is `user-round`, Board View is `square-kanban`. In Tech View and Board View these icons are the design’s: density (`row-height` in Tech View, `card-height` in Board View, custom icons in the design system’s icon set), collapse chevron (`chevron-down`), pin and unpin (`pin` / `pin-off`), Invoiced or Paid lock (`lock`), Unassigned avatar (`user-round`) and the empty state when there are no work orders at all (`clipboard-list`). The filtered no-results state is the List’s, magnifier included (S1-N1). The filter chips and Search use the design file’s icons in every display option, List included, each exactly as the design file draws it. The display switcher (new on every view, List included) shows the design’s slate icons in every view, so it keeps one color as the user moves between views. These are the only changes to List. Every other List icon is unchanged.”
  • S2-R23: “In Tech View and Board View, as in the design: a technician avatar without a photo is a light-grey circle (--sv-grey-100, #EEF2F6) with initials in --sv-grey-600 (#4B5565) in light mode, which meets accessible contrast (6.7:1; the design file’s #697586 is 4.2:1); dark mode uses the design’s dark colors; group and column header names are 14px, weight 600, in the design’s slate text color (#364152), with the design’s smaller initials, in the same --sv-grey-600 (#4B5565) as every other avatar’s initials; Board card customer and total price are weight 500; toolbar and switcher icons are the design’s slate color (the switcher in List too, S1-R9a). Technician avatars, and the Service Advisor avatar, follow density in Tech View as in the design: 20px, 24px and 32px on rows and 24px, 28px and 36px on group headers at Compact, Regular and Comfortable; Board View card avatars stay 24px. The Progress bar is 48 by 4px at Compact, as in the design. The name bubble on hover over a technician avatar on a row or card (the +N included) opens above the avatar, in both views; group and column header avatars keep the browser’s plain name tip, because the name is printed beside them. In Tech View, Status, Waiting On Parts and Progress are left-aligned. The Density and Columns tooltips open above their button, like the switcher’s (S1-R9b), and are hidden while their menu is open. List is unchanged.”
  • S1-R9: “The switcher visually indicates the active display option.”
  • S6-R1: “Offer Compact, Regular, and Comfortable density in Tech View. Board View has no Density control in this release (S3-R11).”
  • Goals: “List remains the default and is unchanged from production. The only changes to the Work Orders page are the display switcher and the icons on the filter chips and Search, which follow the design file in every display option, List included (S1-R9a). Today’s tabs, toolbar layout and Create Work Order button stay as they are.”

From: Chris Ward's answers 12, 21 and 24, "WO Board and Tech View – questions for Chris Ward (14 Oct 2026)" (Google Sheet 1gBGmNB4B1bRrD2ZJvBn1tuvbfxFPjcsKddz_I5H3CvU, tab "Questions for Chris"), answered 15 Oct 2026, read 15 Oct 2026

  • Chris Ward's answer 12: “12. Changed ruling: the filter chips and Search use the design file's icons in every display option, List included, each exactly as the design file draws it. This is the only change to List. New wording in Goals and S1-R9a.”
  • Chris Ward's answer 21: “21. (a). Today's tabs, toolbar and Create Work Order button stay. The only changes to the page are the switcher and the chip and Search icons (Q12).”
  • Chris Ward's answer 24: “24. (a). The tooltips read List, Tech View and Board View. S1-R9b.”
